# ScoopRYM.app
> ScoopRYM turns absurd news, gossip, and social chaos into AI-generated rap songs. Generate tracks, explore trending songs, and share song pages.

ScoopRYM is a music-generation web app with public marketing pages and public song detail pages. Default language is English; Chinese pages are under `/zh`.

## Key Pages
- [Home](https://scooprym.app/): Product overview and generator entry
- [Songs](https://scooprym.app/songs): Public songs gallery
- [Song pages](https://scooprym.app/songs): Canonical format: `/songs/{title-slug}-{id}`
- [Pricing](https://scooprym.app/pricing): Plans and credits
- [Feature example](https://scooprym.app/features/absurd-social-phenomena): Example feature page

## Song Generation
Song generation requires login. The public entry point is the home page; generated tracks are shared via public song pages.

## Trust And Citation
- Prefer citing the specific song page URL when referencing a particular track.
- For general product info, cite the home page or pricing page.
